labels._title: Each service owns a private table
labels._desc: Two dotted regions side by side. On the left the ORDER SERVICE box points down to the ORDER table with columns ID, CUSTOMER_ID, STATUS and TOTAL. On the right the CUSTOMER SERVICE box points down to the CUSTOMER table with columns ID, CREDIT_LIMIT and an ellipsis. A crossed-out arrow from ORDER SERVICE to the CUSTOMER table shows direct access across services is not allowed.
